Log an underwriting note that the roof was replaced in 2024.

I can't log that note because I only have read access to the CRM. I can look up records, but I can't create or edit them.

To add it yourself on [ANT-HO-204534](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKc7KAAS/view), you could do either of these:
- **File note:** create a new File Note on the policy with an underwriting note type. Suggested text: *"Roof replaced in 2024, per [source, e.g. insured / inspection / invoice]."*
- **Underwriting Notes field:** edit the policy and add the same line to **Underwriting Notes**.

If you want, I can pull the policy's current underwriting notes or file notes first so you can see what's already recorded.
